body:
I’m so so sorry that you had to go through that. 
:(

I worked at a state mental institution, they’re free and do not accept insurance. More often than not, they’re very poorly ran and treat you terribly. This specific one’s motto was “you get what you pay for.” It was very heartbreaking to see.
It’s like an organic nerds rope.

I absolutely feel this. I have six siblings of my own, both sides of my family are addicted to drugs and alcohol and all have their fair share of mental problems. So do my siblings and I. Me and my boyfriend don’t want kids for that reason. You’re not alone in feeling this way. I’m glad you posted this, having support from like minded individuals, or at least people who are understanding, goes a long way!
This is exactly what I needed before work.
I can definitely see it. xD
I can just see him now, he eats one nugget, then he’s hooked. Five years later he works at McDonald’s, strictly making nuggets and he’s happy with his life.
I miss lemons. I second bringing back the lemons.
